text:
Ivy: Quick PSA: someone taped a tiny felt crown to the office ficus and wrote "Regent of Low Light" on it. Who started this monarchy? :crown:
Marco: That was me. Felted monarchy is trending in my kitchen. Regal decrees incoming. :sweat_smile:
Zoe: Proposal: create citizenship classes. 1) Water weekly, 2) sing a short plant ballad when pruning. React :one: for citizenship, :two: for leave as is.
Ivy: Also we need a flag for the ficus. I'm volunteering my lunch napkin art skills.
Marco: Duties for the Regent: keep leaves tidy, accept offerings (coffee grounds only), and veto over desk lamp placement near the throne.
TeamBot: Reminder set: "Ficus Check" every Wednesday 9:30am in #random.
Zoe: Tiny oath draft: "I pledge to whisper compliments and not overwater." Thoughts? :seedling:
Ivy: Perfect. Also can we have a sash? I have fabric and glue.
Marco: I drew up a small coronation schedule: quick photo, tiny speech (30s), distribute stickers. Coronation tomorrow at 10:15 by the window.
Zoe: I'll bring a sticker sheet. Who wants to be official photographer? Marco?
Marco: I'll do it. Also handing out honorary titles: "Consul of Compost" and "Shade Minister". Sign up if interested.
Ivy: Love this. The ficus has better HR than some startups. :joy:
TeamBot: Calendar event created: "Ficus Coronation" tomorrow 10:15. Channel: #random.
